title: gold_eden.workforce_status
description: Eden AI Assistant — per-project workforce status. One document per (tenantId, projectId). Summarises scheduled resources (silver.resource_schedule + silver.resource), employment mix (W2 vs 1099), assignment status counts, scheduled duration, actual hours logged (silver.timelog), and an approximate utilisation ratio. There is no silver.worker/crew/equipment table — 'workforce' means scheduled resources, not equipment. Schema mirrors gold/src/eden/load_workforce_status.py shape_doc() exactly.
x-etl-trigger: event-driven on writes to silver.resource_schedule, silver.task (project-keyed). timelog/resource changes are picked up on the next related trigger or batch --rebuild (no project key on those events).

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier. First half of the compound upsert key.

projectId.description: Project identifier cast to string. Second half of the compound upsert key.

_silverLsn.description: PostgreSQL LSN of the silver.project row at write time. Upsert guard against stale overwrites.

dataAsOf.description: UTC effective data snapshot time. Prompt-cache key component.

headcount.description: Distinct resources scheduled on the project (non-deleted schedules).

w2Count.description: Count of assigned resources with employment type W2 (over the assignedResources list).

contractorCount.description: Count of assigned resources with employment type 1099 (over the assignedResources list).

scheduledAssignments.description: Count of resource_schedule rows with status 'scheduled'.

activeAssignments.description: Count of resource_schedule rows with status 'active'.

completedAssignments.description: Count of resource_schedule rows with status 'completed'.

scheduledDurationTotal.description: Sum of resource_schedule.duration across non-deleted assignments. Unit per source (unconfirmed alignment with timelog.time_spent).

hoursLogged.description: Sum of timelog.time_spent reached through the resource_schedule join for this project.

utilizationPct.description: Approximate utilisation = hoursLogged / scheduledDurationTotal * 100. Null when nothing scheduled. Approximate: duration and time_spent unit alignment is unconfirmed.

activeTimelogCount.description: Count of timelog rows with status 'active' (currently clocked-in) for this project.

nextScheduledStart.description: Earliest future start_time among 'scheduled' assignments; null when none upcoming.

assignedResources.description: Up to 100 distinct resources scheduled on the project, ordered by name.

isDeleted.description: Soft-delete tombstone — true when the source silver.project row is soft-deleted. On recompute the Gold doc is marked deleted (never physically removed/orphaned).

deletedAt.description: UTC time the source row was soft-deleted (silver _s_deleted_at); null when live.

_silverWatermarks.description: Per-source-table high-water _s_silver_ts timestamps at the time this document was last written.

lafieldcraft.description: Milliseconds between the loader run and the oldest contributing Silver watermark.
